idea: Themed weeks, Economy day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Gujarat's share of India's goods exports was 22.0% in 2017-18, level with Maharashtra's 23.0%. In 2023-24 it was 30.8%, twice Maharashtra's 15.4%. Gujarat's exports were 2.0 times their 2017-18 value; India's were 1.4 times.

Most of the change came in one step, in 2021-22 (20.8% to 29.8%). The 2024-25 column is not used: its state rows cover only 88% of India's total, and Gujarat's share of that total was 26.6%. Current dollars, not adjusted for prices. A lower share can come with more exports.
source: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Niryat portal (state-wise goods exports, US dollars), as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Table 181. Each share is of the all-India figure in the same table; the state rows add up to 96% of it in 2017-18 and 97% in 2023-24. The 2024-25 column is not used for the shares: its state rows cover only 88% of the total. Blank on the map: Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, A&N Islands, Dadra, Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu.
